description: Returns official recall notices for up to 6 baby or child items in one call: cribs, sleepers, strollers, high chairs, toys, furniture (CPSC), infant formula and baby food (FDA), and car seats. Each item comes back with any recalls, what the notice says to do (stop using, refund, repair kit) and a status. An empty result means no notice was found. Car seats are not searched by name, so they come back as 'check model' with the official recall and rating pages. Safe-sleep and furniture tip-over guidance is included only when the items or the child's age match. A single car that is not a car seat, and a product that is not baby or child gear, are outside this list. Applies to questions about whether baby or child items have recall notices. Results report what the official sources say and are not a safety assessment. Not medical advice.

ages.description: The children's ages, e.g. 'newborn, 3 years'; used only to decide whether safe-sleep guidance applies

country.description: Country whose notices are searched: United States (default), United Kingdom, Canada or an EU/EEA country

items.description: Up to 6 things, brand plus product, one per entry: 'Fisher-Price Rock n Play', 'Similac formula', 'IKEA Malm dresser', 'Graco 4Ever car seat'

name: check_kids
title: Kids: recalls for baby and child gear
